[color=#897236][mono]──── [color=#FFA500][bold]I. Jurisdictional Authority[/bold][/color] ───────────────────────────────[/mono][/color]
The [bold]Triad Defense Force[/bold] are the primary defenders of the sector and citizens residing within. They are responsible for public safety, supporting Sector Command, and stopping the flow of illicit goods.
[head=3][color=#FFA500]Triad Defense Force's Jurisdiction[/color][/head]
[bold]Mandate:[/bold] - 1. Provide public service and safety. - 2. Protect TFA colonial personnel and outposts, such as Medical Dispatch and Venmar Station. - 3. Support Sector Central Command in performing their duties, if required. - 4. Enforce the [textlink="law" link="SectorLaw"] throughout the sector.
[bold]Emergency Authority:[/bold] - Under extreme conditions where sector stability is in danger or confirmed external threats are enroute to the sector, TDF can invoke emergency authority, placing the whole sector under direct command of the Chief Enforcer to enable suitable reactions to the threat.
